Author: Stefan Haubold <stefan@entire.io>
Date:   Wed Aug 12 14:29:49 2026 +0200

    perf: adopt go-git's scoped ignore walk, drop the .gitignore workaround
    
    Bumps go-git to main for go-git#2309, which replaces the flat ignore-pattern
    list with per-directory gitignore.Scope. Patterns now inherit down the walk and
    an excluded ancestor short-circuits, so a rule prunes its subtree regardless of
    which .gitignore declares it.

    "e2e/artifacts/" rule was one level too deep for the old flat walk and never
    pruned, so every Worktree.Status() descended all of e2e/artifacts. The rule had
    to move to e2e/.gitignore; it no longer does, so the layout goes back to what it
    was before that commit and e2e/.gitignore is removed.
    
    Measured against this repo with an 8001-directory e2e/artifacts tree and the
    root-level rule restored:

    benefits every repo, not just ones with a large ignored tree.

    below it, so every ordinary build has the fix. A deliberate replace directive
    pointing go-git at a pre-#2309 checkout brings the per-hook cost back.
